validacion.passwordFormato: Must include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number

login.subtitulo: Welcome back. Sign in to your account.
login.cuentaCreada: Account created! You can sign in now.

solicitar.subtitulo: First, let's confirm the email is yours.
solicitar.yaRegistradoDetalle: This email already has an account. Sign in or use another email.
solicitar.finRechazada: Someone answered "It wasn't me" from the email, so this sign-up was cancelled.
solicitar.finVencida: The link expired before you authorized it.
solicitar.finInactiva: This request is no longer active.
solicitar.revisaSubtitulo: We sent you a link to authorize your sign-up.
solicitar.revisaTexto: Open the email we sent to {{email}} and tap Authorize and continue. The link expires in 30 minutes.
solicitar.spam: If you don't see it, check your spam folder.
solicitar.esperando: Waiting for your authorization. This page will move on by itself.

registro.errorComprobar: We couldn't check the link. Please try again.
registro.invalidoSubtitulo: You need a valid link to sign up.
registro.completaSubtitulo: Your email is authorized. We just need your details.
registro.yaRegistrado: This email is already registered. Sign in or use another email.

autorizar.autorizandoSubtitulo: One moment, we're confirming your email.
autorizar.error: We couldn't authorize the sign-up. Please try again.
autorizar.invalidoSubtitulo: This link can no longer be used.
autorizar.listoSubtitulo: You can now finish signing up.
autorizar.listoTexto: Go back to the page where you started signing up: the form will open by itself. You can close this tab.

rechazar.invalidoSubtitulo: This link can no longer be used.
rechazar.listoSubtitulo: No account will be created with your email.
rechazar.listoTexto: We cancelled the link and you won't receive any more sign-up emails for the next 24 hours.
rechazar.titulo: Didn't ask to create an account?
rechazar.subtitulo: Someone entered your email on Metamorfosis.
rechazar.texto: If it wasn't you, confirm below. No account will be created and the link will stop working.
rechazar.siFuiYo: It was me, I want to sign up

cerrarSesion.texto: You'll need to sign in again with your email and password to see your goals.
